refusals.command: npm test --workspace cli -- test/watcher-stall-reset-payloads.test.mjs > $TMPDIR/after.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)|^not ok|^ok .*honest hung" $TMPDIR/after.log | head -30

polling.command: ls harness-runs/STOP harness-runs/PAUSE <main_repo>/harness-runs/AUTONOMOUS_STOP 2>/dev/null; cat harness-runs/.dispatch_counter 2>/dev/null || echo 0

network_refusals.command: npm test --workspace cli -- test/watcher-stall-reset-payloads.test.mjs > $TMPDIR/after.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)|^not ok|^ok .*honest hung" $TMPDIR/after.log | head -30
